q: What carbon data do OEMs ask auto part suppliers in Bawal for?
title: Bawal auto parts supplier carbon data
short: Carmakers ask for Scope 1 and 2 emissions, often per part or per kg, plus renewable share and a reduction plan. Some ask for material footprints for steel, aluminium and plastic parts. Twelve months of power and fuel bills and part-wise production are the starting point.
audience: Auto component makers in Bawal and the Rewari belt

ul: Scope 1 and 2 totals and per part.

p: Steel, aluminium and plastic suppliers' figures, or labelled factors.
Use machine hours or weight to split plant energy across part numbers.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
